name: TrueReview
summary: Review management for local businesses: SMS and email review requests, Google review monitoring and replies, AI response suggestions and multi-location plans.
best_for: local businesses that want to send review requests by SMS and email, watch their Google reviews and answer them from one dashboard, with up to five locations on one Premium plan
skip_if: most of your customers are outside the US and Canada and you need SMS requests; or you run many locations and the monthly per-location add-ons on top of Premium outgrow your budget
honest_knock: The yearly discount is steep but the terms make every payment non-refundable, and the trial needs a credit card. Starter is a single user with five AI reply suggestions a month, unused requests expire each month, and SMS works only in the US and Canada after verification.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-15 on truereview.co/pricing with the Monthly and Yearly toggles, and on its help-centre price list for request add-ons) TrueReview has three plans. Starter is $49 a month, or $29 a month on a yearly plan ($348 a year); Small Business $99, or $59 yearly ($708); Premium $299, or $179 yearly ($2,148). The base plan cards show a dollar sign without a currency code; the add-on price list is labelled USD. Premium includes five locations; more are sold per location per month, $39 each for the first ten extra, then $35, $32 and $29 from the 31st, and add-on locations are billed monthly even when the plan is yearly. Extra review requests are sold as recurring packs, from $12 a month for 100 to $600 a month for 10,000; one-time purchases are billed at the default price without those discounts. The free trial lasts 14 days with up to 250 SMS and email requests, and the terms say all accounts require a valid credit card. Monthly and annual payments are non-refundable under the terms, and you must cancel at least 24 hours before renewal.

compare_with.name: NiceJob
compare_with.why: NiceJob is in our dossiers too and covers the same job of asking customers for reviews: when we read it on 13 October 2026 Starter was $75 a month and Pro $125. TrueReview starts lower, $49 a month or $29 on a yearly plan, but meters its plans in review requests (250 on Starter). Compare what your monthly request volume costs on each, not the entry price.
